rejection_summary.title: The Capture
rejection_summary.reason: Strong scientist-led experiment and reality/time premise, but whole-runtime evidence indicates very weak progression, little meaningful rule discovery, and poor execution; not defensible at the 82 threshold.

rejection_summary.title: The Krone Experiment
rejection_summary.reason: Scientific-intelligence investigation of a mysterious destructive signal fits the premise profile, but available whole-runtime evidence is too thin and flags pacing, repetitive exposition, rushed/unsatisfying resolution, and ambiguity; insufficient for a confident complete DNA vector at 82+.

rejection_summary.title: Habitat
rejection_summary.reason: Biology, accelerated evolution and an experiment-gone-wrong are strong topic matches, but the film shifts into family/teen drama and fantasy-horror around a living house rather than sustained scientific investigation or rule discovery; below threshold.
